verdicts_or_reports.expected: With Deck for new cards set to Decide by note type, Basic should use French, the deck last used to save a Basic note.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The editor initializes Basic to Spanish, the deck list's current deck, despite Decide by note type. Reopening repeats it.
steps: Set Settings > General > Deck for new cards to Decide by note type.
Open Add, choose Basic and French, enter QA deck test and save.
Return to deck list, open Spanish and return without reviewing.
Open Add from the deck list: Basic deck shows Spanish instead of French.
Cancel and reopen Add: Spanish appears again.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Decide by note type should initialize Basic with its remembered French deck, consistently with switching away from and back to Basic.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Opening Add initializes Basic to Spanish. Switching Type to Basic (and reversed card) and back to Basic changes the deck to French, without selecting a deck. Closing/reopening again shows Spanish.
steps: Settings > General > Deck for new cards: choose Decide by note type.
From Add, choose Basic, choose French, save a temporary Basic note.
Return to deck list; tap Spanish, then Back.
Tap Add, then Add again. Hide keyboard. Deck shows Spanish.
Change Type to Basic (and reversed card), then change Type back to Basic: Deck now shows French.
Back out and reopen Add: Basic deck shows Spanish again.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Reopening the tag filter retains the selected verb tag; confirming unchanged keeps only comer visible.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Reopening resets verb to unchecked. Pressing Select without edits replaces (tag:verb) with (deck:*) and shows all four Spanish cards. Reproduced twice.
steps: More options > Filter by tag; check verb and Select. Only comer appears with query (tag:verb).
More options > Filter by tag again; verb is unchecked.
Press Select without changes: query becomes (deck:*) and all 4 Spanish cards appear.
Repeat selecting verb and reopening: selection is lost again.
